description: A new branch in the top-level expression parser plus a parse_while method that reads the while, do, and done keywords and builds a WhileExpr.

steps.description: This adds parsing for `while` in `parser.py`. The page says to add a branch in your top-level expression parser.
`parse_expr` checks whether the current token is `WHILE`. If it is, it returns `self.parse_while()`; otherwise the existing branches handle the rest.

`parse_while` records the current line, expects `WHILE`, parses the condition with `parse_expr`, expects `DO`, parses the body with `parse_expr`, expects `DONE`, and returns a `WhileExpr` built from those parts.

title: Parsing the while Expression
